# Change Proposal

## Summary
What is proposed?

## User problem
Who is affected and what problem does this solve?

## Existing behavior
Link the source file or issue and describe current behavior.

## Proposed behavior
Describe the intended result and out-of-scope items.

## Implementation plan
List files, assets, dependencies, integrations, and architecture changes.

## Accessibility and privacy
Describe keyboard, responsive, personal-data, and security impact.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Observable requirement.
- [ ] Regression check.
- [ ] Documentation update.

## Rollback
How will the change be reversed?
